dataset.name: No-imputation measurement-consistency benchmark for the P4V035/P6V035 S355 analogue pair
dataset.scope: Preserve V8U through V9H, verify the 55 cached V9H payloads, extract documentary definitions from the already acquired Zenodo metadata, and calculate time-grid, threshold-interval, recorded-path work and DIC robust-field summaries without imputing missing values or assuming cross-channel synchronization. Do not infer a complete pulse duration, stress, constitutive or fracture parameters, acquire additional payloads, run a solver or perform impact work.

sources.use: Definitions of DIC frame labels, virtual trigger, shortened incident bar, processed displacement boundary conditions, acoustic velocity and quasi-static relative displacement.

sources.title: Shear Band Formation with Split Hopkinson Bar Experiments
sources.use: Provenance target cited by the Zenodo description; the exact equation and correction-factor value are not used in V9I.
Exact per-entry hashes, paths, units and cached payload identities.
Visual transcription of displayed y-z axes and incident-wave arrow only.

documentation_transcription.DIC_filename_times: Frame output times in file labels are associated with an imaginary trigger at the left end of the shortened 300 mm incident bar used in the SHPB simulation setup.
documentation_transcription.bar_boundary_conditions: BC_Inc and BC_Trans displacement boundary conditions are calculated from incident/transmission-bar strain-gauge signals using equation 12 of the cited paper, an acoustic bar velocity of 4639 m/s and a correction factor.
documentation_transcription.quasi_static_curve: Force-displacement values use specimen relative displacements evaluated by DIC.

coordinate_image_observed.possible_mapping_not_assumed: CSV x numerically spans the displayed horizontal range while CSV z is zero, but V9I does not relabel CSV x as displayed z without an explicit source definition.

methods.missing_values: Preserve blank cells as missing; exclude them only from the statistic for their own field; never replace them with zero or interpolate them.
methods.bar_derivative: First difference divided by exact adjacent time interval; no smoothing.
methods.quasi_static_work: Trapezoidal integral along the recorded force-displacement path. One kN*mm equals one joule. Positive and negative displacement-increment contributions are retained separately.
methods.cross_channel_alignment: Report numerical overlap after converting bar seconds to milliseconds, but do not assert synchronization.

evidence_policy.observed_fact: An explicit source description, header, unit, image label or numeric value in the verified V9H payloads.
evidence_policy.local_archive_claim: No local WTC archive claim is introduced and the source archive is not rescanned.
evidence_policy.model_hypothesis: The 5 percent signal threshold, linear quantile definition and descriptive comparison rules.
evidence_policy.derived_result: Time-grid, overlap, extrema, recorded-path work, valid-count and quantile summaries; not stress, material response or event probability.
evidence_policy.unknown: Exact equation 12 implementation, correction-factor value, CSV-to-displayed coordinate mapping, absolute synchronization and applicability to WTC or CF6 materials.
